findings.summary: Redemption success does not invalidate catalog affordability state
findings.details: On success this mutation invalidates request and wallet query families, but the store and item sheet gate redemption from item.canAfford on the separate ['redemption-catalog', ...] browse/detail caches. Those catalog queries have 2-5 minute stale windows, so after a successful reservation the user can return to the store or reopen the same item and still see stale canAfford/shortfall state.
findings.tierReason: severity=medium → advisory regardless of confidence or alreadyHandled
findings.recommendation: Invalidate the catalog browse/detail query family on redemption success: queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['redemption-catalog'] }), and add a regression test covering post-submit return-to-store affordability refresh.

classificationRules.blockingThreshold: severity critical/high AND confidence >= 0.70 AND not alreadyHandled
classificationRules.advisoryThreshold: severity medium/low OR confidence < 0.70 OR alreadyHandled
